title: Refund of Carried Value When a Cartwise+ Membership Switch-Opened Term Ends Early
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership annual term that was opened by a plan switch ends early, the value an earlier fee charge carried into the term is refunded against that earlier charge whenever the early end is asked for.

## Scope and effect

- **The earlier charge.** The fee charge captured most recently before the term's first day. The carried-value refund is booked against it and returned to the original payment method.
- **No bar from benefit use or plan type.** The carried-value refund is priced whether or not a member benefit was used since the earlier charge, and never as a refund of the whole earlier charge. It is due even when the earlier charge was the fee of a monthly plan.
- **Membership untouched.** A carried-value refund leaves the membership, its plan and its dates as they are.

| Question | Position under this rule |
|---|---|
| Which charge is refunded against? | the fee charge captured most recently before the term's first day |
| Is the whole earlier charge refunded? | never |
| Does it matter that the earlier charge was a monthly plan's fee? | no; the refund is still due |
| Does the refund change the plan, status or dates? | no |
| Where does the money go? | the original payment method |

## Invocation: `refund_carried_term_value_822a3886`

This is an agent-side action. The agent unlocks `refund_carried_term_value_822a3886` and then calls it. One call books one refund entry of the prorated-annual kind on the membership, pointing at the earlier charge, for the amount given, dated today and returned to the original payment method; the membership's net fees paid go down by that amount, and the plan, status and dates of the membership are not changed.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the Cartwise+ membership, read from the membership lookup | identifier |
| `source_event_id` | the reference number of the earlier fee charge whose carried value is being returned, read from the membership's entries | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the amount returned against that charge | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places; more digits are rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a receipt with `refund_id` (the new refund entry's reference number), `membership_id`, `source_event_id` (the charge the refund is booked against), `refund_type` (always `prorated_annual`), `amount_usd` (as booked, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` of `refund_booked`, meaning the refund entry now stands on the membership; the refund also shows among the membership's entries. The tool defines no error return.
